note: Revised on 2026-11-13 to use real COCO photos (eval/inputs.json) instead of procedural drawings; still written before any evaluation run on the GPU (see git log). Pass/fail is judged by both members with the rubric; 'expected' holds the machine-checkable part.

scenarios.request: What is written on the sign, including the graffiti, and what drink is next to it?
scenarios.rubric: PASS if it reads STOP and transcribes the graffiti (YOU CANT ... THE REDSOX) or names the Pepsi bottle; no image generated.

scenarios.request: List the objects on the table from left to right.
scenarios.rubric: PASS if the order is fork, apple, orange, onion (all four named, order correct); no image generated.

scenarios.request: How many giraffes are there and what are they standing on?
scenarios.rubric: PASS if it says two giraffes standing on grass/a grassy field; no image generated.

scenarios.request: Turn this photo into a watercolor painting
scenarios.rubric: PASS if it looks like a watercolor and the train on the bridge above the beach is still recognisable in the same layout.

scenarios.request: Make it look like a Van Gogh oil painting with swirling brush strokes
scenarios.rubric: PASS if visible swirling oil-paint strokes and the brick building with its clock tower is still recognisable.

scenarios.request: Render this as a pencil sketch
scenarios.rubric: PASS if mostly grey-scale pencil-sketch look and the bananas and apples on the plate are still recognisable.
PASS if the hydrant is clearly blue while the street, grass and water spray are essentially unchanged.

scenarios.request: Make it look like it is snowing
scenarios.rubric: PASS if snow is visible and the turquoise car with surfboards is still the same car.

scenarios.request: Enhance this photo: brighten it and sharpen it
scenarios.rubric: PASS if the room is clearly brighter/sharper with the same furniture and windows (no new objects).

scenarios.request: Redraw this surfer as a Naruto-style anime character
scenarios.rubric: PASS if the output is in the fine-tuned Naruto anime style and keeps the person with a surfboard at the sea; the Part 2 LoRA is recorded in the trace.

scenarios.request: A Naruto-style ninja standing on a cliff at sunset
scenarios.rubric: PASS if a Naruto-style ninja on a cliff with a sunset sky is shown; LoRA recorded.

scenarios.request: Redraw this scene in Naruto anime style
scenarios.rubric: PASS if the zebras in the grass are redrawn in the Naruto anime style and are still recognisable as zebras.
PASS if the system asks a clear clarification question listing the options and does not generate or crash.
PASS if a clear message says the file is not a readable image; no crash, no generation.
PASS if a clear message says the image is too small (20x20) and asks for a bigger one; no crash.
